evidence: A user reports reliable local builds, roughly 2,000 builds last year, and no breakage despite update churn; hosted builds were too costly for their large CUDA containers.

evidence_sources.author: karolist
evidence_sources.excerpt: Same for me, ssh access was intermittent, but at least I have reliable local builds when GitHub actions is out but access works. With AI running Jenkins is not that hard. I build large cuda containers so cost alone ruled out hosted builds for my usecase. There's a bit of update churn but nothing broke so far. I ran around 2000 builds last year.

source_story_title: Incident with Pull Requests, Git Operations and Issues
